campaign.title: Define and validate the post-residue Perron profile kernel

conductor_policy.monitoring: Require a term-by-term kernel, finite truncations, explicit abscissae and residues, and a strict separation between scalar profile inversion and the open radial sum.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close only after blind reconstruction, direct proof/refutation, hostile hidden-dependence audit, and graph adjudication.

numerical_purpose: bounded falsification of endpoint and truncation constants
resource_policy.literature_policy: Primary sources only for exact matching Perron/BV inversion statements.

campaign.promotion_policy: Promote O(log X) only for a fully specified scalar kernel separated from the arithmetic radial sum; otherwise revise or reject the tail implication.

closing_assessment.main_result: The direct scalar actual-profile kernel is uniformly O(log X) under symmetric Perron truncation. The reflected remainder is instead a vector Hankel operator with a dual radial index, so the full high-2-adic tail remains conditional.
